posPage.subtitle: A local-only tool for shop profiles, inventory, fractional quantities, tax-aware bills, and offline JSON backups.

faq: Does the app upload my shop profile, inventory, or bills?
No. The POS tool runs in your browser. The app does not send your shop profile, inventory, customer information, or bills to a backend.
How do I reuse my shop profile and inventory next time?
Save a profile in this browser and load it when you return, or download and import a profile JSON. Browser storage can be cleared, so keep a JSON backup. Nothing is saved automatically.
Can I use fractional inventory quantities?
Yes. Quantity fields support decimals for count, weight, volume, length, and package units.
How do taxes and other charges work?

Set a primary and optional additional percentage tax; both use the same inclusive or exclusive setting. The optional flat charge is added once per bill after percentage taxes. This is a general calculator, not tax or accounting advice; verify the rules that apply to your shop.
What bill number will my customer see?
Each new bill starts with the prefix you choose in your shop profile, followed by the date and a unique code. Older profile files without a prefix use INV.
How do I share a bill with a customer?
Print / download bill PDF opens the browser print dialog, where you can print or choose Save as PDF. Download customer image creates a PNG of the bill.
What is the difference between bill exports and JSON?

PDF and PNG are readable bill copies to share with your customer. JSON is for you: profile JSON contains your shop profile and inventory, while bill JSON also contains the current bill and its items. The same import button accepts either JSON type.

displayPage.title: Display & Presentation
displayPage.subtitle: Turn PDFs, Word documents, and images into a browser-based fullscreen slideshow for lessons, events, photo frames, and in-store displays.
displayPage.choose: Choose files or drop them here
displayPage.hint: PDF, DOCX, or images · up to 100 MB per file
displayPage.empty: Add files to preview their pages and build a playlist. You can exclude individual pages without changing the original files.
displayPage.privacy: Files are rendered locally in browser memory and are not uploaded. The playlist is temporary and is cleared when you close or refresh this page.
faq: Are my files uploaded to {{siteName}}?
No. Your files are rendered in this browser and kept in the current page. They are not uploaded; closing or refreshing the page clears the playlist.
Which files can I display?

PDFs, .docx Word documents, and image formats that the current browser can decode. PDF and DOCX pages become separate slides. A browser-supported image becomes one still slide; animated images are not played as animation. Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked before use.
How do I remove a page from the show?
Uncheck Include on a slide to keep it in your playlist but skip it during playback. Use the X button to remove that slide from the playlist entirely. The original file is never changed.
How does per-slide timing work?

A blank duration uses the playlist default. Set an individual slide to a number of seconds to override it, or set it to 0 for manual advance. Manual-advance slides remain visible until you use Next or a keyboard shortcut.
How do I show this on a TV or classroom screen?

Start the show, choose the fullscreen control in the player, and connect or cast your browser to the display using your device’s normal screen-sharing method. F11 toggles browser fullscreen on many computers; Escape exits fullscreen. TV browsers and remotes differ, so test the connection and controls before an event.
Will the screen stay awake all day?

The tool can request the browser Screen Wake Lock API when available, but this is best-effort. The browser may release it when the tab is hidden, the device may not support it, and TV or operating-system power settings can override it. For long-running signage, adjust the display’s own sleep settings.
What time and date are shown?
The optional overlay uses the device’s current local date and time, including its locale and timezone. It is not a synchronized clock or a scheduled advertisement system.

flatten.title: Flatten PDF Forms
flatten.subtitle: Flatten supported interactive form fields in a PDF using your browser. Review the saved file.
faq: Is the PDF uploaded for processing?
The selected PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website may make separate requests for advertising and supporting resources.
What does this tool flatten?
It attempts to flatten PDF form fields into their visual appearance. It does not guarantee that all annotations or other interactive content are removed. Check the saved file.
Will the rest of the document stay unchanged?
The PDF is rewritten without rasterizing its pages, but results can vary. Check the saved file, including its appearance, text and other features.
Can flattened form fields be edited again?
Flattened form fields cannot normally be edited as form fields again. Keep the original file if you may need to edit them later.

base64.title: Base64 & Hash
base64.subtitle: Encode or decode UTF-8 text, create URL-safe Base64, or calculate SHA fingerprints for text and files.
faq: Does this tool upload my data to {{siteName}}?
No. Encoding, decoding, and hashing use browser APIs locally. Selected files are read in memory and never uploaded.
Is Base64 encryption?
No. Base64 is a reversible encoding, not encryption. Anyone can decode it; never use it to protect secrets.
Can a hash be reversed?
Cryptographic hashes are designed to be one-way fingerprints. This tool offers SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512. SHA-1 is included for compatibility, not for security-sensitive new designs.
What does URL-safe Base64 change?
It substitutes hyphen and underscore for plus and slash, and omits padding when encoding. This is useful in URLs and filenames; decoding must use the matching option.
Why can’t some Base64 data be decoded as text?
The decoder displays UTF-8 text only. Base64 may represent arbitrary binary data such as an image or archive; that data is not valid UTF-8 text.
Is extracting text safe on {{siteName}}?
Text extraction runs in your browser. The selected PDF is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing; PDF.js may request supporting character-map resources from a content delivery network.
Can this tool read scanned PDFs or photos of text?
This tool extracts embedded digital text. Scanned documents or image-only PDFs require optical character recognition (OCR), which this tool does not support.
Does the extraction preserve layout formatting?
The tool separates extracted text by page, but it does not preserve the exact visual layout, columns, or typography of the PDF.
Is there a limit on how long the document can be?
There is no fixed page limit in the interface, but large PDFs may take longer or exceed available browser memory. Scanned pages are not OCR-processed.

pdfToImages.title: Convert PDF to Images
pdfToImages.subtitle: Render PDF pages as PNG images in your browser.
faq: Is converting PDF to images safe on {{siteName}}?
PDF pages are rendered in your browser and are not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
What is the quality of the converted images?
Pages are rendered as PNG images at the tool’s selected scale. Larger scales create larger images and use more memory; check the results at the size you need.
What image format is produced?
Pages are rendered as lossless PNG images.
Is there a limit on how many pages I can convert?
There is no fixed page limit in the interface, but large documents and high render scales may take longer or exceed available browser memory.

organize.title: Organize PDF Pages
organize.subtitle: Reorder, rotate, or delete PDF pages visually in your browser.
faq: Is organizing PDF pages safe on {{siteName}}?
The selected PDF is rendered and reorganized in your browser; it is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
Can I remove specific pages from my PDF?
Yes. Click the trash icon on any page thumbnail to remove that page from the final document.
Will rotating pages affect document quality?
Rotation updates the page's rotation without re-compressing or rasterizing vector text.
Is there a limit on how many pages I can organize?
There is no fixed page limit in the interface, but rendering and reorganizing large PDFs may take longer or exceed available browser memory.

pageNumbers.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF
pageNumbers.subtitle: Add page numbers, headers, and footers to a PDF using your browser.
faq: Does adding page numbers re-render existing text on {{siteName}}?
No. The original page contents, fonts, vector drawings, and images remain untouched. New text streams are overlaid at specified coordinates.
Can I omit the cover or title page?
Yes. Enable the Skip first page checkbox to start numbering from page 2 onward.
Are my confidential documents uploaded to a server?
The selected PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website may make separate requests for advertising and supporting resources.

watermark.title: Watermark PDF
watermark.subtitle: Add a configurable text watermark to selected PDF pages in your browser.
faq: Are my watermarked documents uploaded to a remote server on {{siteName}}?
The selected PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
Will the watermark obscure my existing text?
You can reduce the opacity to 10%–25% to make underlying text and graphics easier to read. Review the result before sharing.
Can I watermark only specific pages?
Yes. Select all, odd or even pages, or enter a custom page range (for example 1-5, 8).

nup.title: N-Up PDF (Multiple Pages Per Sheet)
nup.subtitle: Arrange two or four PDF pages on each sheet for handouts and presentation notes.
faq: What is N-Up printing on {{siteName}}?
N-Up scales multiple pages (2 or 4) and positions them on one sheet, reducing the number of sheets required.
Will text or vector drawings lose clarity when scaled?
Pages are embedded as PDF page objects rather than rasterized, so text and vector elements remain scalable. Check the result at your intended print size.
Are my files uploaded anywhere during layout composition?
The selected PDF is arranged in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website may make separate requests for resources and advertising.
What makes {{siteName}} sanitization different from standard PDF editors?

The tool removes the selected document information, XMP metadata, PieceInfo data, page thumbnails, and supported JavaScript actions. It cannot guarantee removal of every kind of hidden information or content embedded in page artwork.
Will sanitizing a PDF alter my visible text, images, or layout?
The tool targets metadata and selected PDF structures, not visible page content. Check the sanitized file and do not rely on it as the sole method for concealing sensitive information.
Are my confidential files uploaded to any server?

The selected PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The tool removes the metadata types described on this page; it cannot guarantee removal of every kind of hidden information.
Does {{siteName}} receive my password or PDF?
The password and selected PDF are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
Will the protected PDF retain selectable text and links?

This tool renders each page to an image before rebuilding the PDF. Text may no longer be selectable or searchable, and links, forms, and other interactive features may not be retained. Review the result before replacing your original.
Do the printing and copying permissions prevent every kind of copying?

No. PDF permissions are honored differently by different readers and cannot prevent screenshots or other ways of capturing content. Use a strong password to control opening, and do not treat permission flags as copy-proof security.
Is unlocking PDFs safe on {{siteName}}?
The password and selected PDF are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
Do I need to know the document password?
Yes. Enter a password you are authorized to use to open the PDF. This tool cannot recover a forgotten password.
Will unlocking alter the formatting or contents of my PDF?

This tool rebuilds each page as an image. Text may no longer be selectable or searchable, and links, forms, and other interactive features may not be retained. Check the output before replacing your original.
Can I re-encrypt the file later?
Yes. Once unlocked, you can open the Protect PDF tool at any time to assign new passwords or custom permissions.

jsonFormatter.title: JSON Formatter
jsonFormatter.subtitle: Beautify, minify, and validate JSON data with clear syntax errors and optional key sorting.
faq: Is my JSON sent to {{siteName}}?
No. Parsing, sorting, and formatting happen locally in your browser. The tool does not evaluate code or make network requests with your JSON.
Does sorting keys change my data?
It changes the order of object keys recursively for readability. Array order and values are retained. Avoid key sorting if the original order is meaningful to your workflow.
Does validation check a schema?
No. Validation checks whether the input is syntactically valid JSON. It does not validate application-specific fields or a JSON Schema.

sample.title: Sample PDF Generator & QA Sandbox
sample.subtitle: Generate sample PDFs with configurable layouts, synthetic test data, and optional malformed-file cases in your browser.
faq: What is the Mixed-Geometry Stress Test?

A single multi-page PDF where each page has a different size or orientation (A4 portrait, A3 landscape blueprint, 90-degree clockwise rotation, and a long mobile POS receipt). It tests if your PDF viewer or thumbnail pipeline handles non-standard pages.
Why would I generate a corrupted PDF?

Software developers and QA engineers need to test error handling when users upload broken or incomplete files. Our chaos modes simulate truncated downloads, invalid magic headers, and scrambled cross-reference tables safely.
Is the Synthetic PII dataset real customer data?

No. The generator creates synthetic names, payment-like numbers, and tax-like identifiers for software testing. They are not real customer data and should not be used for transactions or identity verification.
How does the file size simulation work?
When you select 1 MB, 5 MB, or 10 MB, the generator injects padded binary data streams into the document, allowing you to test file-upload limits without hunting for arbitrary large files.

imagesToPdf.title: Convert Images to PDF
imagesToPdf.subtitle: Assemble JPG, PNG, and WebP images into a PDF using your browser.
faq: Are my photos uploaded to an external server on {{siteName}}?
Selected images are converted in your browser and are not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The site makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
Which image formats are supported?
JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP images are supported and converted to PDF streams.
Can I change the order of images before making the PDF?
Yes. Use the up and down arrow buttons next to each preview thumbnail to arrange the pages.

inspect.title: PDF Structure & Metadata Inspector
inspect.subtitle: Review PDF version, metadata, encryption status, page geometry, and selected document features in your browser.
faq: Why inspect PDFs on {{siteName}}?
Use the report to review basic PDF structure and look for features such as JavaScript actions. It is not a full security audit, malware scanner, or PDF/A conformance validator.
Are my confidential documents uploaded to a remote server?
The selected PDF is analyzed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website makes separate requests for resources and advertising.
Are my images uploaded to {{siteName}}?
No. Your images are decoded and converted in browser memory using HTML Canvas; the files are not sent to our servers.
Which formats can I convert?
This tool accepts PNG, JPG/JPEG, and WebP, and can output those same formats. SVG is not supported because canvas conversion rasterizes vector artwork.
What happens to transparency?
PNG and WebP can retain transparency. JPG does not support transparency, so transparent areas are filled white.
Does conversion preserve metadata?
No. Canvas re-encoding creates a new image and does not carry over metadata such as EXIF camera or location information.
Are images uploaded to {{siteName}}?
No. Image processing runs locally in browser memory with HTML Canvas. Original files are not modified or uploaded.
Will every image become smaller?
Not necessarily. Some images are already optimized, and lossless PNG output can be larger. Results show the actual size change; try a smaller dimension or a lossy format for a smaller file.
How does the dimension limit work?
The selected maximum applies to the longer side. The original aspect ratio is preserved, and images smaller than the selected limit are not enlarged.
What happens if I convert a transparent image to JPG?
JPG cannot store transparency. Transparent areas are filled with white when producing JPG output.

compress.title: Compress & Optimize PDF
compress.subtitle: Rewrite PDF structure and remove selected metadata in your browser. Size savings depend on the document; image data is not downsampled.
faq: How does PDF compression work on {{siteName}}?

The tool rewrites the PDF using object streams and removes standard document metadata. The Strong option also removes selected XMP metadata, editing information, and embedded page thumbnails. It does not downsample images.
Will text or vector drawings lose clarity?
The tool does not rasterize pages or downsample embedded images. It rewrites PDF objects and metadata, so the resulting size may be similar to or larger than the original.
Are my confidential documents uploaded anywhere?
The PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The website still makes separate network requests for resources and advertising.

crop.title: Crop & Trim PDF
crop.subtitle: Trim outer margins, remove printer bleed marks, and adjust PDF page boundaries in your browser.
faq: How does cropping work on {{siteName}}?
Cropping adjusts the internal CropBox and MediaBox parameters of the PDF. This trims empty white borders, printer bleed marks, or unwanted headers without degrading typography or vector quality.
Are my confidential files uploaded anywhere?
The PDF is cropped in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. The site may still make separate requests for advertising and supporting resources.
Can I crop only odd or even pages?
Yes. You can select all pages, odd pages, even pages, or specify a custom page range.

delete.title: Delete PDF Pages
delete.subtitle: Remove unnecessary, blank, or confidential pages from a PDF using your browser.
faq: Is it safe to delete pages from confidential PDFs on {{siteName}}?
The selected PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to {{siteName}} for processing. Advertising and other site requests are separate from the file operation.
Can I remove the cover page or blank trailing pages?
Yes. Use the quick buttons for the first or last page, or type comma-separated values like 1, 10 to remove them.
Will deleting pages affect document links or quality?
The tool removes selected pages without rasterizing the remaining page content. Check forms, links, or other document features in the saved copy.

faq.question: Are my extracted pages uploaded to MyDailyUtils?
faq.answer: Never. The parsing and extraction occur strictly in local client memory. No documents ever leave your machine.

faq.question: How do I specify multiple separate page ranges?
faq.answer: Use dashes for ranges and commas for separates (e.g., "1-4, 7, 9-12"). You can also click "All Pages" to select everything.

faq.question: Can I split password-protected PDFs?
faq.answer: Encrypted PDFs must be unlocked before client-side extraction can access their page tree.

faq.question: Will splitting affect the original document quality?
faq.answer: No. Pages are extracted with their vector content, fonts, and images intact at full fidelity.

faq.question: Are files uploaded to MyDailyUtils?
faq.answer: No. Files are read, rendered, and assembled in your browser memory.

faq.question: Does the export preserve PDF text quality?
faq.answer: Regular PDF pages remain vector-based when possible. Images and rendered DOCX pages are raster content. Encrypted PDFs and pages with redactions are rendered as images; password-protecting the final PDF also rasterizes its pages.

faq.question: How do I make a linked table of contents?
faq.answer: In the workspace, click the pin on each page you want listed and enter a heading. The exported PDF adds a contents page at the beginning; each heading links to its page. Pages without a heading are not listed.

faq.question: How do page numbering and “Skip first page” work?
faq.answer: Choose None to omit numbers, or choose a header/footer position and format such as “Page {page} of {total}”. Skip first page hides the number on the first document page (after the contents page, if one is added); later pages retain their actual output page numbers.

faq.question: Can I add a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Yes. When prompted, enter either its open/user password or its owner password. Passwords stay in this browser. Encrypted source pages are rasterized in the finished output, so their text is not preserved as selectable vector text.

faq.question: Can I password-protect the final PDF?
faq.answer: Yes. Set a user/open password and optionally an owner password with printing/copying restrictions. The current protection method rasterizes the final pages; text selection/search and clickable contents links are not retained.

faq.question: What do the page-size and compression options do?
faq.answer: Choose A4 or US Letter to standardize output pages, or Preserve mixed sizes to keep each source page’s dimensions. Compression affects raster inputs only; size targets are best-effort and do not guarantee a final file size.

faq.question: Can I save one page without exporting the whole document?
faq.answer: Yes. Open Zoom & edit on a workspace page to export that page as its own PDF or image. You can also rotate, crop, add blackout redactions, and adjust image fit there.

sections.heading: What Merge PDF does
paragraphs: Merge PDF joins two or more PDF files into one document. The pages of each file are copied in the order you choose, so the first page of your first file becomes page 1 of the result and the last page of your last file becomes the final page. The tool works with whole files, which makes it a good fit for combining a cover letter with an application, several scanned receipts into one expense report, or separate chapters into a single handout.

sections.heading: Getting the order right
paragraphs: After you add your files they appear in a list with up and down buttons. Use them to move a file earlier or later, and remove any file you added by mistake. The order of the list is the order of the finished PDF, so check it before you merge. If you need to rearrange individual pages inside the merged file, merge first and then use Organize PDF, or pull out the pages you want with Split PDF.

sections.heading: Tips for good results
paragraphs: Name your files so they sort sensibly before you add them, for example 01-cover.pdf and 02-form.pdf, so the list starts close to the right order. Very large PDFs, or many files at once, use a lot of memory on your device. If the page slows down or the merge fails, merge in smaller batches and then merge the results.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Merge PDF has no fixed file-size limit of its own, but your browser and device memory set a practical one. Password-protected PDFs cannot be merged. If you know the password and are allowed to remove it, use Unlock PDF first. Your files are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Split PDF does
paragraphs: Split PDF takes the pages you choose from a PDF and saves them as a new PDF. You enter single page numbers, ranges or a mix, and the tool builds one new document containing exactly those pages. It is a quick way to pull a single form out of a long scan, to send only the relevant pages of a contract, or to cut a large document down before sharing it.

sections.heading: How to enter pages
paragraphs: After you choose a file the tool shows how many pages it has. Type page numbers separated by commas and use a hyphen for a range: 1, 4, 7 gives you three pages and 2-5 gives you pages two to five. You can combine both, such as 1-3, 7, 10-12. The pages come out in their original order whatever order you type them in, and a page you type twice is included once. Numbers outside the document are ignored, so check the page count shown before you extract.

sections.heading: Getting several separate files
paragraphs: The result is always a single PDF made from the pages you selected. To produce several separate files, run the tool once for each set of pages. If you want to remove pages rather than keep them, Delete PDF Pages is quicker, and Organize PDF lets you reorder, rotate or delete pages visually.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: A password-protected or damaged PDF may fail to load. Unlock PDF can remove a password if you know it and are allowed to. The downloaded file name includes the page selection and a timestamp, so you can keep several versions side by side. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Compress PDF does, and what it does not
paragraphs: Compress PDF makes a PDF smaller by removing information the document does not need in order to display, and by saving it with a more compact internal structure. It does not re-encode or shrink the pictures inside your file. Results therefore depend on what the PDF contains: documents with a lot of editing leftovers, thumbnails or metadata can get noticeably smaller, while a PDF made mostly of large scanned photos usually shrinks only a little.

sections.heading: The two optimization levels
paragraphs: Basic optimization is lossless. It clears document properties such as title, author, subject, keywords, creator and producer, and saves the file in a compact structure, so what you see on the pages does not change. Strong optimization does the same and also removes the document-level XMP metadata, editing data left behind by applications such as Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign, and the small preview thumbnails stored for each page. These items are not part of the visible page content. One side effect of clearing properties is that a PDF reader may no longer show a document title.

sections.heading: If the file is still too large
paragraphs: After compressing, the tool shows the original size, the new size and how much was saved. If the saving is small, the file size is probably dominated by images. In that case reduce the images before you build the PDF: shrink them with Image Compressor and combine them with Image to PDF, or scan at a lower resolution. If a form or portal asks for a file under a specific size, check the result before you upload it, because this tool cannot target an exact size.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Password-protected or damaged PDFs may fail to load. Keep your original file, since the compressed copy has its metadata removed. Your file is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What Image to PDF does
paragraphs: Image to PDF turns one or more pictures into a single PDF with each image on its own page. It accepts JPG, PNG and WebP images, which makes it useful for phone photos of documents, screenshots, receipts and scanned pages that arrived as images. The result is an ordinary PDF that you can email, print or upload to a form.

sections.heading: Choosing page size and margins
paragraphs: Choose A4 portrait, A4 landscape, US Letter or Fit to Image. A4 and US Letter give you standard page sizes for printing and for portals that expect them. Fit to Image makes each page the size of its picture and uses no margin. For the fixed sizes you can pick no margin, a small margin of 20 points or a standard margin of 40 points, where 72 points is one inch.

sections.heading: Order and file size
paragraphs: Images are added in the order you select them, and you can move any image up or down before you create the PDF. The tool does not apply extra lossy compression to your pictures, and WebP images are converted to PNG in your browser first, so the PDF will be about as large as the images you put in. To keep it small, reduce the pictures first with Image Compressor.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Only JPG, PNG and WebP images are accepted, so convert other formats first. Many high-resolution photos at once can be slow on a phone, so convert in smaller batches if the page struggles. Your images are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.

sections.heading: What PDF to Images does
paragraphs: PDF to Images turns every page of a PDF into a separate PNG image. Use it to share a single page as a picture, to place pages into a slide deck or chat, or to get image versions of a document for a tool that does not accept PDFs.

sections.heading: Quality and file size
paragraphs: Pages are rendered at twice their standard size, which gives sharp text and graphics for screens and most documents. PNG is lossless, so the images stay crisp, but a page with photos or heavy graphics can produce a large file. If you need smaller images, run the PNG files through Image Compressor and choose JPG or WebP.

sections.heading: Saving your pages
paragraphs: When the conversion finishes, each page appears with its own download button. Files are named after your PDF with the page number, for example report_page_3.png, so you can download only the pages you need.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: All pages are converted in one go, so a PDF with very many pages uses a lot of memory and may be slow on a phone. Password-protected or damaged PDFs may fail to convert. Your PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing. For some documents with non-Latin fonts, the PDF viewer library may download font mapping files from a public CDN, jsDelivr, but your document itself is not sent anywhere.

sections.heading: What Image Compressor does
paragraphs: Image Compressor reduces the file size of JPG, PNG and WebP images. You choose a quality, optionally limit the longest side of the picture, and optionally switch format. The tool shows how much smaller each result is, so you can decide before you save. It is handy for photos that are too large to email, to upload to a form, or to publish on a web page.

sections.heading: The settings that matter
paragraphs: Quality runs from 10 to 95 and controls lossy compression for JPG and WebP: lower values give smaller files with more visible artefacts. The maximum dimension option shrinks the picture so that its longest side is at most 2560, 1920, 1280 or 800 pixels, which often saves more than quality alone. For format you can keep the original where possible, or choose JPG (small for photos, no transparency), WebP (efficient, keeps transparency) or PNG (lossless, can be larger). With keep, PNG and WebP images stay as they are and JPG stays JPG.

sections.heading: Choosing settings
paragraphs: For photos, start at 75 percent quality and a longest side of 1920 pixels or less, then lower either one if the result is still too big. PNG is lossless, so the quality slider has no effect on PNG output. To shrink a PNG, reduce its dimensions or convert it to JPG or WebP. Screenshots and graphics with sharp edges usually look best as PNG or WebP. If a result comes out larger than the original, the tool tells you so, and you can try a lower quality or smaller dimensions.

sections.heading: Limits and privacy
paragraphs: Compression redraws the picture, so lossy formats lose some detail and information such as camera or location data is generally not carried over. Your original file is never changed. Very large images use a lot of memory, and formats other than JPG, PNG and WebP are not accepted. Your images are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to MyDailyUtils for processing.
